ContentLayoutDraftEnvelope.title: Content layout draft envelope
ContentLayoutDraftEnvelope.description: Fields shared by every draft (stateless) mutation request: the draft tree the edit is applied to, plus the optional root source used for resolvability.

layout.description: The current draft element tree the edit is applied to. Defaults to an empty tree.

rootSource.description: Optional root source the draft is resolved against for resolvability. An entity type (a value from `GET /api/_info/content-system-entity-types.json`), a section (`header`, `footer`), or `none`. With it unset, only intrinsic well-formedness is evaluated.

ContentLayoutVersionEnvelope.title: Content layout version envelope
ContentLayoutVersionEnvelope.description: The optimistic-concurrency token shared by every persisted mutation request.

expectedVersion.description: Optimistic-concurrency token: the stored layout's `updatedAt` as last read, compared at millisecond precision. `null` for a layout that was never updated. A mismatch is rejected with `409` and an unparseable value with `400`; nothing is written in either case. Take this value from the `updatedAt` the layout read returned.

type.description: The element type to insert (becomes the new element's `component`). A registered type name; see `GET /api/_info/content-system-element-types.json`.

parentElementId.description: Id of the parent element to insert into; the element is inserted at the root when omitted.

slot.description: Name of the parent slot to insert into. Required when `parentElementId` is given.

index.description: Zero-based position within the target list. A null, negative, or out-of-range value appends at the end.

bindingSpecificationId.description: Optional source-qualified id (`source:id`) of a binding specification to apply onto the inserted element atomically after scaffold (data requirements, seeded input defaults, and attribution), in the same edit. A value from the `bindingSpecifications` map on the element's type entry in `GET /api/_info/content-system-element-types.json`. The specification's declared `type` must equal `type` (else `400 bindingTypeMismatch`); an unregistered id is rejected with `400 bindingSpecificationNotFound`, and nothing is inserted on either failure.

elementId.description: Id of the element to remove. Its subtree is removed with it.
Id of the element to move.

newParentId.description: Id of the new parent element; moves to the root when omitted. Moving an element into itself or a descendant is rejected with `400`.

newSlot.description: Name of the target slot. Required unless a same-parent move reuses the current slot.

index.description: Zero-based position within the target list. A null, negative, or out-of-range value appends at the end.

elementId.description: Id of the element to replace.

newType.description: The element type to replace it with (becomes the element's new `component`). A registered type name; see `GET /api/_info/content-system-element-types.json`. Children, wiring, and property values the new type cannot hold are reported back in `orphaned`, `droppedWiring`, and `droppedProperties`.

elementId.description: Id of the element to duplicate. The copy and its subtree receive freshly minted ids, returned in `affectedElementIds`.

index.description: Zero-based position to place the copy at within its sibling list. Placed as the next sibling when omitted.

elementIds.description: Ids of the elements to wrap. They must be siblings in one slot, or all root-level. Must be non-empty and contain no duplicates.

containerType.description: The element type of the new container to wrap the elements in (becomes its `component`). A registered type name; see `GET /api/_info/content-system-element-types.json`.

slot.description: Name of the container slot the wrapped elements are placed into.

containerElementId.description: Id of the container element to unwrap. Its children take its place and the container is removed.

element.description: The element subtree to splice in (for example an `orphaned` subtree from an earlier edit, or a copy). Every id in it is re-minted server-side; the placed ids are returned in `affectedElementIds`.

parentElementId.description: Id of the parent element to attach into; attaches at the root when omitted.

slot.description: Name of the parent slot to attach into. Required when `parentElementId` is given.

index.description: Zero-based position within the target list. A null, negative, or out-of-range value appends at the end.

elementId.description: Id of the element to bind the specification onto.

bindingSpecificationId.description: Source-qualified id of the binding specification to apply (`source:id`). A value from the `bindingSpecifications` map on the element's type entry in `GET /api/_info/content-system-element-types.json`.

ContentLayoutUpdateElementPropertiesRequ.title: Update element properties request (draft)
ContentLayoutUpdateElementPropertiesRequ.description: Writes property values onto one element and drops property keys from it. At least one of `values` and `removeKeys` must be non-empty, else the request is rejected with `400`. The operation rejects with `400` in a fixed order and the first failing rule reports: `mutationTargetNotFound`, `mutationUnknownType`, `mutationPropertyUnknown`, `mutationPropertyConflict`, `mutationPropertyValueRejected`, `mutationPropertyLanguageKeyInvalid`.

elementId.description: Id of the element whose property values are updated.

values.description: Property values to write, keyed by property key, each in its stored shape. A translatable property's value is a language map keyed by language id in lowercase UUID hex; a `null` writes a present null under a non-translatable primitive. Values are written as supplied — nothing is normalized and no type default is overlaid. A key must name a primitive property the element's type declares (a reference property and a `resolvedBy` storage key are rejected with `mutationPropertyUnknown`), and its value must match the declared type (else `mutationPropertyValueRejected`); a translatable property's language map may carry only keys that are language ids in lowercase UUID hex (else `mutationPropertyLanguageKeyInvalid`). An empty map serializes as `[]`.

removeKeys.description: Property keys to drop from the element. Each must name a primitive property the element's type declares and must not also appear in `values` (else `mutationPropertyConflict`). A dropped key with a type default stays absent in the draft; the write-boundary seeder refills it on save.

type.description: The element type to insert (becomes the new element's `component`). A registered type name; see `GET /api/_info/content-system-element-types.json`.

parentElementId.description: Id of the parent element to insert into; the element is inserted at the root when omitted.

slot.description: Name of the parent slot to insert into. Required when `parentElementId` is given.

index.description: Zero-based position within the target list. A null, negative, or out-of-range value appends at the end.

bindingSpecificationId.description: Optional source-qualified id (`source:id`) of a binding specification to apply onto the inserted element atomically after scaffold, in the same committed edit. A value from the `bindingSpecifications` map on the element's type entry in `GET /api/_info/content-system-element-types.json`. The specification's declared `type` must equal `type` (else `400 bindingTypeMismatch`); an unregistered id is rejected with `400 bindingSpecificationNotFound`. The op throws before the repository write, so nothing is persisted on either failure.

ContentLayoutPersistedUpdateElementPrope.title: Update element properties request (persisted)
ContentLayoutPersistedUpdateElementPrope.description: Writes property values onto one element of the stored layout and drops property keys from it. At least one of `values` and `removeKeys` must be non-empty, else the request is rejected with `400`. The operation rejects with `400` in a fixed order and the first failing rule reports: `mutationTargetNotFound`, `mutationUnknownType`, `mutationPropertyUnknown`, `mutationPropertyConflict`, `mutationPropertyValueRejected`, `mutationPropertyLanguageKeyInvalid`.

elementId.description: Id of the element whose property values are updated.

values.description: Property values to write, keyed by property key, each in its stored shape. A translatable property's value is a language map keyed by language id in lowercase UUID hex; a `null` writes a present null under a non-translatable primitive. Values are written as supplied — the operation normalizes nothing and overlays no type default. A key must name a primitive property the element's type declares (a reference property and a `resolvedBy` storage key are rejected with `mutationPropertyUnknown`), and its value must match the declared type (else `mutationPropertyValueRejected`); a translatable property's language map may carry only keys that are language ids in lowercase UUID hex (else `mutationPropertyLanguageKeyInvalid`). An empty map serializes as `[]`.

removeKeys.description: Property keys to drop from the element. Each must name a primitive property the element's type declares and must not also appear in `values` (else `mutationPropertyConflict`). The committing write runs the write-boundary seeder, so a dropped key with a type default is committed carrying that default again.

ContentPreviewEntityRequest.title: Content preview request
ContentPreviewEntityRequest.description: An unsaved draft layout plus the real entity and sales-channel context to render it against.

layout.description: The draft element tree to render. Must be non-empty.

entityType.description: The entity type to render against, selected by exact match. One of the values from `GET /api/_info/content-system-entity-types.json`.

entityId.description: Id of the entity to hydrate against; the entity must exist.

salesChannelId.description: Sales channel whose context is synthesized for rendering.

languageId.description: Optional language id overriding the synthesized sales-channel context.

currencyId.description: Optional currency id overriding the synthesized sales-channel context.

domainId.description: Optional domain id overriding the synthesized sales-channel context.

customerId.description: Optional customer id overriding the synthesized sales-channel context.

queryParameters.description: Optional values forwarded as the render request's query parameters; defaults to none. `elementId` selects a single element for partial preview. A member name PHP casts to an integer (`0`, `12`, `-3`) is rejected with 400: the stored envelope is a string-keyed map and cannot carry an integer key.

ContentLayoutDiagnoseRequest.title: Content layout diagnose request
ContentLayoutDiagnoseRequest.description: An unsaved draft layout to resolve and diagnose, plus an optional root source. The whole body is optional; an empty body diagnoses an empty tree.

layout.description: The draft element tree to diagnose. Defaults to an empty tree.

rootSource.description: Optional root source the draft is resolved against. An entity type (a value from `GET /api/_info/content-system-entity-types.json`), a section (`header`, `footer`), or `none`. With it unset, only intrinsic well-formedness is evaluated.
